cohort: 126 patients with endometriosis, 71 with a history of C-section and a control group without a history of C-section
finding: A multivariate regression analysis identified prior c-section as an independent risk factor for abdominal wall endometriosis.
mod_finding: The c-section group had significantly more minimally invasive pelvic procedures and multiple adhesions and endometriosis foci at intraoperative look.
